entry.description: Child chooses "a park keeper" for "tramp" where the answer is "a person with no settled home", picking a meaning that belongs to neither sense of the word.
entry.childHint: That meaning belongs to a different word. Read the sentence again.
entry.approvalMethod: written review — vocabulary in context, annie 2026-08-08

stem.text: Read line 18. What does 'the carol of happy birds' mean?

options.value: A Christmas song the birds had learned.
A church bell ringing far away.
options.execution: A bell is nowhere in the passage; it arrives with the Christmas sense and nothing else.

options.value: The sound of the river chattering.
A shout from someone in the meadow.

stem.text: Read line 65. The Mole was 'seated in the stern of a real boat'. What is the stern?

carriers.key: The back part of the boat.

options.value: The oars that push the boat along.
A soft seat with a cushion on it.
options.execution: A cushioned seat is nowhere in the passage; 'seated in' invites it.

options.value: The rope that held the boat to the bank.
The back part of the boat.
